metadata.question: In areas across the northeastern Pacific Ocean, were sea surface temperatures cooler in August 2019 than the average for the same month from 1985-2012?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about sea surface temperatures in the northeastern Pacific Ocean, specifically comparing August 2019 to the 1985-2012 August average. For sea surface temperature data, I should use: - MODIS Terra or Aqua for recent data (2019) - Need a dataset that goes back to 1985 for the baseline The best dataset for this would be the NOAA Optimum Interpolation Sea Surface Temperature (OISST) dataset, which provides daily SST data from 1981 to present. Let me structure this: 1. Define the northeastern Pacific region (roughly 20°N-60°N, 180°W-120°W) 2. Get August 2019 SST data 3. Get August average from 1985-2012 as baseline 4. Compare and determine if 2019 was cooler I need to be careful about: - Data availability checks - Cloud/quality masking for SST data - Valid pixel counts - Proper comparison logic The OISST dataset has a 'sst' band and quality flags that I should use for masking. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define northeastern Pacific Ocean region const region = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-180, 20], [-120, 20], [-120, 60], [-180, 60], [-180, 20]] ]); // 2. Data Acquisition - NOAA OISST dataset const sstCollection = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/CDR/OISST/V2_1') .select('sst'); // Get August 2019 data const aug2019 = sstCollection .filterDate('2019-08-01', '2019-08-31') .filterBounds(region); // Get baseline data (1985-2012 August averages) const baseline = sstCollection .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(1985, 2012, 'year')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(8, 8, 'month')) .filterBounds(region); // Check collection sizes const aug2019Size = aug2019.size().getInfo(); const baselineSize = baseline.size().getInfo(); console.log(`August 2019 images: ${aug2019Size}`); console.log(`Baseline (1985-2012) August images: ${baselineSize}`); if (aug2019Size === 0 || baselineSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate means const aug2019Mean = aug2019.mean(); const baselineMean = baseline.mean(); // Get pixel counts to check for valid data const aug2019Count = aug2019Mean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 25000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('sst').getInfo(); const baselineCount = baselineMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 25000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('sst').getInfo(); console.log(`August 2019 valid pixels: ${aug2019Count}`); console.log(`Baseline valid pixels: ${baselineCount}`); if (aug2019Count === 0 || baselineCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculate mean temperatures const aug2019Temp = aug2019Mean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 25000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('sst').getInfo(); const baselineTemp = baselineMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 25000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('sst').getInfo(); console.log(`August 2019 mean SST: ${aug2019Temp?.toFixed(2)}°C`); console.log(`Baseline mean SST: ${baselineTemp?.toFixed(2)}°C`); console.log(`Difference: ${(aug2019Temp - baselineTemp)?.toFixed(2)}°C`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (aug2019Temp === null || baselineTemp === null || isNaN(aug2019Temp) || isNaN(baselineTemp) || aug2019Temp > 50 || baselineTemp > 50 || // Unrealistic SST values aug2019Temp < -5 || baselineTemp < -5) { console.log("C3"); } else if (aug2019Temp < baselineTemp) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
